entries.source: Regesta Boica 11 (Regesta sive rerum Boicarum autographa ad annum usque MCCC. 11 = Continuatio 7), 30 June 1399
entries.german: Altman Kemnater Landrichter zu Lengfeld bestättigt der Abtissin Anna von Pülnhofen einen Gerichtsbrief des Chunrad von Rosenberg, Vizthum zu Amberg (dd. Montags vor S. Kathreintag 1379) gemäss welchem sie mit Volg, Frag und Urtail behabt habe, dass sie von ihren Amtleuten in der Landschrann zu Lengfeld Recht thun soll an kleinen Sachen seinem (des Rosenbergers) gnädigem Herrn an dessen grossen Rechten, und dass sie darum von einem Amtmann zu Lengfeld geschetzt werden soll. G. zu Kalmüntz am Montag nach Sunbenden. (c. 1 Sig.)
entries.english: Altman Kemnater, Landrichter at Lengfeld, confirms to Abbess Anna of Pülnhofen a court letter of Chunrad von Rosenberg, Vizthum zu Amberg (dated the Monday before St. Catherine's day 1379), according to which she had established by pursuit, inquiry and judgment that she shall have justice done by her officials in the Landschrann at Lengfeld in minor matters, for his (the Rosenberger's) gracious lord, in respect of his great rights, and that she shall for this be protected by an official at Lengfeld. Given at Kallmünz on the Monday after the solstice (Sunbenden). (With 1 seal.)

facts.content: issued a court letter in 1379 for Abbess Anna of Pülnhofen, according to which she had established by pursuit, inquiry and judgment that she is to have justice done by her officials in the Landschrann at Lengfeld in minor matters and is to be protected by an official at Lengfeld.
confirmed to Abbess Anna of Pülnhofen the court letter of Konrad von Rosenberg, Vizthum zu Amberg, dated the Monday before St. Catherine's day 1379.
